newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.10 to 0.25 cent. Carryover selling seen as boxed beef prices falling on reduced retailer interest and packers lowering bids for cash cattle.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Further spillover from live cattle seen. Index also down and corn seen up.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.100 to 0.300 cent. Carryover from limit losses Tuesday with cash hogs called lower.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.300 to 0.800 cent. Carryover from limit losses, cash weak, increased hog slaughter seen and out-of-town withdrawl not as large as some expected.
